title: The Clean Border
author: Edmund Montrose
blurb: Quentin Nystrom, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
